name: Pleasure Divers
summary: Family-run SSI dive shop at Arcadia on Magnetic Island, open since 1994. It runs dive courses from Open Water to specialties, guided shore and night dives, introductory dives, kids programmes and private guided snorkel tours. Most diving is from the shore, with the main sites a short walk from the shop.
standouts: Longest running dive centre on Magnetic Island, operating since 1994
Only on-site dive training pool on Magnetic Island and in the Townsville region
Open Water courses capped at 4 students

trips.title: SSI Open Water Diver
trips.summary: A two day SSI course that certifies you to dive to 18 metres with a buddy. Day one covers pool skills and a first ocean dive, and day two adds three more ocean dives, an exam and your licence. Classes are capped at four people, and the ocean dives are shore dives off Magnetic Island's bays.
highlights: Pool training and 4 ocean shore dives
Digital e-learning kit is yours to keep
trips.departsFrom: Pleasure Divers, 10 Marine Parade, Arcadia, Magnetic Island

prices.label: Private course, one-on-one instructor for 2 days
prices.note: Includes everything the standard course includes. Email to arrange dates.

prices.label: Hire of mask, snorkel and fins, per day
prices.note: Optional, if you do not bring your own

includes: SSI certification, a licence to dive to 18m
4 ocean shore dives off Magnetic Island's bays and beaches
Scuba equipment hire (including wetsuit) for 2 days
bring: Own mask, snorkel and fins for training (hire is $25 per day)
Footwear, swimwear, towel, sun protection and wet-weather protection, and warm clothes if necessary
Your own lunch, or buy lunch at the Arcadia General Store or Arcadia Bakehouse (food and drinks are not provided)
trips.requirements: Minimum age 14 for the regular scheduled courses. Ages 10 to 13 by special arrangement (Junior Open Water). Swim 200m without mask, snorkel or fins. Float or tread water for 10 minutes without a flotation device. Complete the SSI Pre-Dive Medical screening questionnaire (a dive medical may be needed). Complete the self-paced SSI e-learning before arriving. People over 45 may need a physician's approval.
trips.checkNotes: Booking is through a Rezdy calendar widget embedded on the course page (no per-trip link), so the page URL is recorded. Usually offered twice a week, weekend courses available, dates are in the calendar. Online bookings close 3 days before the course start. Class is capped at 4. Conflicts: the Kids Scuba page lists an 'Open Water Diver' for ages 15 and over as 3 days, starting every Tuesday, with gear hire for 3 days, linked to a Rezdy product named 'ssi-3-day-open-water-course' (https://pleasuredivers.rezdy.com/111122/ssi-3-day-open-water-course); this page says 2 days. The Kids Scuba page also gives 15+ for the regular course and 12+ for Junior Open Water, while this page says minimum 14 and Junior from 10. Reschedule transfer fee is $50. A certified diver (for example a parent of a Junior student) may buy a place on the course for $499 and take part in the whole course.

trips.title: SSI Advanced Open Water
trips.summary: A two day SSI course with five training dives, three from the beach on Magnetic Island on day one and two from a dive boat on day two, including a deep dive. It certifies you to dive to 30 metres. Pleasure Divers does not run the boat, which is operated by another business.
highlights: Day 1: three shore training dives at Alma Bay or Geoffrey Bay
Day 2: two boat dives including a deep dive, lunch on board
Boat boards at Townsville 7:00am or Magnetic Island 7:45am
trips.departsFrom: Day 1: Pleasure Divers, 10 Marine Parade, Arcadia, Magnetic Island (shore dives at Alma Bay or Geoffrey Bay). Day 2: boat from Townsville or Magnetic Island
includes: SSI certification, a licence to dive to 30m
Boat travel on Day 2 (including lunch on board)
trips.requirements: Open Water Diver licence, from any agency. Recent dive experience: if you have not dived in the past 12 months, book a Refresher before enrolling. At least 10 logged dives (divers may book straight after their Open Water, but it is best to build up some fun diving first). Complete the SSI Pre-Dive Medical screening questionnaire (a dive medical may be needed). Minimum age 12; ages 12 to 14 are limited to 21m until age 15.
trips.checkNotes: Booking is through a Rezdy calendar widget embedded on the course page, so the page URL is recorded. Runs once per month. Day 1 meets at the shop at 8:30am and finishes at 4:30pm. Day 2 vessel boards at Townsville 7:00am or Magnetic Island 7:45am and returns to Magnetic Island 4:45pm or Townsville 5:10pm; the site says the vessel is not operated by Pleasure Divers and its conditions of travel apply. The site says the SS Yongala may or may not be visited on Day 2 depending on the day and weather. SSI renamed Advanced Adventurer to Advanced Open Water in October 2025; some menu links and the old /advanced-adventurer-course address still use the old name and redirect here. The page heading offers the five dives as Buoyancy, Navigation, Ecology, Deep and possibly a boat dive, decided by the instructor.

trips.title: SSI Scuba Skills Update (Refresher)
trips.summary: A three hour refresher for certified divers who are rusty, run mostly in the shop's own training pool with an SSI dive pro. It reviews buoyancy, equipment handling and emergency procedures, and is tailored to why you booked it. Divers from any agency can take it.
highlights: 3 hour session of theory and practical
Held in the on-site dive training pool
Open to divers certified by any agency
Recommended before diving the SS Yongala

trips.title: SSI Diver Stress and Rescue
trips.summary: A two day SSI course on preventing and managing stress and emergencies, for yourself and your dive buddies. Day one is three pool sessions and day two is three open water sessions and an exam. You do not need an Advanced certification to enrol.
highlights: Day 2: 3 open water sessions and an exam
Open Water certification from any agency is enough
Minimum 2 participants, runs once per month

At least 10 logged dives is recommended. Complete the medical screening questionnaire (a dive medical may be needed). Current First Aid, CPR and Oxygen Provider certification is required to enrol, for example HLTAID011 Provide First Aid and CPR and HLTAID015 Provide Advanced Resuscitation and Oxygen Therapy. Minimum age 12.

The nav calls this 'Rescue Diver Course'; the page heading is 'SSI Diver Stress & Rescue'. The site notes the itinerary is flexible and the open water sessions run when conditions suit. E-learning takes about 5 hours.

trips.summary: An SSI Divemaster internship at the shop, learning by assisting on real courses, leading dives and sharpening rescue skills. Most dive time comes from shore dives off Magnetic Island, so there is little waiting for a boat.

trips.title: Introductory Scuba Dive
trips.summary: A first scuba experience for people with no certification: a briefing, a pool lesson and one ocean dive with an SSI instructor. You walk across to the local shore dive site. The ocean dive is a 30 minute tour to a maximum depth of 12 metres, with no more than four participants per instructor.
highlights: Briefing, pool lesson and 1 ocean dive

bring: Swimwear, towel, sun protection and wet-weather protection, and warm clothes if necessary
Footwear, for the walk to the shore dive site

trips.requirements: 12 years or older. Basic swimming ability. Complete the SSI Pre-Dive Medical screening questionnaire (a dive medical may be needed). People over 45 may need a physician's approval.
trips.checkNotes: Option Two on the page. Offered Tuesday to Sunday at 1pm, pending availability; closed Mondays. Duration conflict: the option card says 3 hours, the FAQ says typically about 2.5 hours (the Kids Scuba page also says 2.5 hours); the option card was used. Deposit conflict: the option card calls the $25 deposit non-refundable, the FAQ says deposits are refunded with 48 hours or more notice. If the ocean dive is cancelled for conditions, you are offered a new date, a full refund or a 1 hour pool session for $95. Online bookings close 24 hours before the start. This is also the Introductory Ocean Dive listed for ages 12 and over on the Kids Scuba page at the same price, linked to the same Rezdy product. A Private Experience for mixed certified and introductory groups is $800 for up to 4 family members (see offers).

trips.title: Certified Guided Shore Dive
trips.summary: A guided beach dive for certified divers with a local dive professional, with easy entry from the shore and no boat. You walk about five minutes from the shop to a dive site chosen on the morning, usually Alma Bay or Geoffrey Bay, where the Moltke shipwreck lies. A single dive takes 2 to 2.5 hours, and a double dive takes about 4 hours.
highlights: Qualified local guide, groups of no more than 4 to 6 certified divers
Alma Bay (maximum depth 6m to 8m) and Geoffrey Bay with the SS Moltke shipwreck (maximum depth 8m)
Solo travellers welcome, you are buddied with another diver or the guide

trips.summary: A monthly guided shore night dive on Magnetic Island, followed by a beachside barbecue with the other divers. A qualified local dive pro leads the dive, and gear and torch hire are included. It suits experienced divers who have dived at night before.
highlights: Full gear hire and torch hire included
Led by a qualified local dive pro

In place of this, divers can show evidence of previous recent logged night dives, an Advanced qualification and/or a minimum of 20 recent logged dives. A first night dive should be taken through the Night specialty course. After 2 years or more out of diving, book a Refresher.

The site recommends an orientation dive on the day of the night dive (price not stated). The last SeaLink ferry to Townsville is 10pm Sunday to Tuesday and 11pm Wednesday to Saturday. The page says it is out of the water by about 8:30pm.

trips.summary: A guided night dive timed for the annual coral spawning, held off the shore on Magnetic Island. A qualified local guide leads the dive, and a sausage sizzle follows. It is for experienced divers with recent dive history and night diving experience.

checkNotes: Booking: the site-wide Book Now button goes to a Rezdy catalog, https://pleasuredivers.rezdy.com/catalog/101955/ssi-dive-courses (not opened). It is not a per-trip link and is not recorded on any trip. Per-trip Rezdy links appear on the Kids Scuba, Night Diving, Introductory Dives and Specialty Courses pages. The Open Water, Advanced, Refresher, Rescue, Certified Guided Shore Dive and Private Guided Snorkel Tour pages embed a Rezdy calendar widget instead, so those trips carry the page URL as their booking link. Not bookable online or enquiry only: Divemaster Internship, Introductory Dive pool session, scuba gear rental. Left out of trips: Science of Diving specialty ($249, a dry classroom course with no dives; Rezdy link https://pleasuredivers.rezdy.com/122046/ssi-science-of-diving); scuba gear rental and Night Dive Gear Rental (hire, enquiry only); snorkel hire (hire, no booking needed; the self-guided snorkel trails at Nelly Bay and Geoffrey Bay, and $7 snorkel trail swim cards sold at the shop). Run by other operators, not Pleasure Divers: the Yongala and Museum of Underwater Art (MOUA) day trips described on the Yongala and MOUA page (Yongala Dive departing Alva Beach, Ayr, $320; Adrenalin Dive and Snorkel, $460; SeaLink MOUA snorkel, $325). The site says it can help book these and can privately guide divers aboard the Yongala vessel; no price is given for that. Hours: Tuesday to Sunday 8:30am to 4:30pm, closed Mondays. All diving is from the shore. Gift vouchers are covered in the Terms and Conditions (expire 12 months from purchase) but no page or link for buying them was found. Photo-credit check: the site shows an award badge (Best of Queensland Experience 2024), SSI Dive Center, Green Fins and Submerged Nation badges; these were not recorded as photos, and only the Green Fins membership is repeated in standouts because the About page says so in text. The site is served at www.pleasuredivers.com.au; pleasuredivers.com.au redirects to it. Phone is shown as (07) 4778 5788. All prices are shown as including GST. The site says the Environmental Management Charge for the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority is included in its prices. Left off the page as pool-only, not on the sea: Introductory Dive, Pool Session Only.
